alt: 老師蹲在孩子身旁，親切示範如何握筆並仔細指點畫作，孩子專心聆聽。
scene_prompt: Meaning: 耳提面命 is earnest, personal, repeated guidance and instruction. A caring art teacher crouches beside a seated child, speaking gently face to face at the child's eye level while pointing to a simple drawing on the table and demonstrating how to hold a brush; the child listens attentively and looks reassured. Their close, sincere interaction shows careful advice, not scolding. Other students quietly paint in soft-focus background. Natural anatomy, exactly two arms and two legs per visible person, teacher's hands correctly pointing and holding the brush, child hands naturally hold paper/brush. Stable table and pots, no readable text or letters.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO readable text, letters, numerals, captions, logos, watermarks, brands or recognizable existing characters. Contemporary school art classroom. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft watercolor and colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, restrained natural colors, no 3D.
